text: Can you pull together every site on Marrow Agrisupply you can find across #central-team? List each with where it comes from. Need it before the customer call.
reply_text:

2. Pine Crossing: you posted on 2026-06-09 that their appointment screen only shows the afternoon shift. Hollis said he'd check the shift template.
3. Wichita store (probably Marrow, please confirm): on 2025-07-02 you mentioned an 8am check-in with "the Wichita store dispatcher." That came right after Tobias said your Zoom was hosting the Marrow office hours, but the message doesn't actually name Marrow.

The Tulsa hub in that channel belongs to Tansley Parcel, not Marrow.

There are probably more sites I couldn't find. Marrow's June 9 rollout tracker had three rows marked only "waiting," and the channel never names those stores. The store-by-store list you were sending Hollis that day was never posted in #central-team either. If it went to him by DM or email, the rest of the sites are probably there.
